title: Taiwan High Speed Railway Construction Project
lineage: Original publisher's text inspected. Saved notes paraphrase the identified passages.

passages.locator: Financial improvement and continuing operation; High-speed railway route and stations
passages.note: The bureau dates the first opening to 5 January 2007 and lists the seven stations of the opening section.

The bureau identifies Taiwan Shinkansen Corporation as the supplier of the core system and the Tokaido–Sanyo Shinkansen as the electromechanical reference. It identifies the Series 700 as the design basis for the 12-car 700T and specifies adaptation to Taiwan’s route and geographical conditions.
